jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
If you’re a proactive, problem-solving team player who likes to take ownership of your work, this could be the job for you. As a senior member, you not only bring an abundance of expertise to your team, but you also know how to inspire, uplift and bring out the best in your colleagues. Always striving for continuous improvement, you adapt to change easily and are always eager to learn. In a flat organization like Suitsupply, there are ample opportunities to broaden your horizons by moving between different teams, and strengthen your skill set within the wider organization. Suitsupply is growing in every aspect IT-wise, and therefore, we're looking for Senior Software Engineers to join us on the journey of becoming the global tailoring expert.

What you will do

Build new applications and services and refactor existing ones, using a variety of Azure resources, like Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB & Azure table storage, ARM Templates and many more
Create, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines
Write unit tests and keep an eye on code quality
Write and maintain documentation
Depending on the team you will join, your scope might include integrations with 3rd party providers (e.g. Supply Chain & Warehouse Management Systems, OMS, POS, Salesforce Service Cloud or Commerce Cloud, Appointment scheduling, Workforce Management, ERP Microsoft Dynamics, WeChat etc)
Work in an environment that embraces AI-tools to streamline development processes, with opportunities to expand your experience in the field.

Who you are

IT education, Computer Science or Software Engineering
5+ years of experience with C#, .Net
Experience with DDD, Microservices, Azure, Web API’s, ServiceBus, Messaging queue, Unit testing and Git
Mentality: team player, eager to learn, striving for continuous improvement
Strong ownership
Nice to have: Experience working with AI-powered development tools like CursorAI, GitHub Copilot or other similar tools.

What you will get

Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off.
Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you’ll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step.
Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization.
Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products.
Compensation: We offer a competitive salary based on relevant skills and experience.

# .NET Developer

## About the Role

Spilberg IT Dev Careers, part of Vibe Group, is seeking a .NET Developer who is passionate about innovation, software development, and building scalable solutions. You will work as part of an ambitious, self-organizing Scrum team developing a modern recruitment suite used by professionals every day.

The platform combines smart features and integrations with a simple user experience and follows **API-first, mobile-first, security-by-design, and privacy-by-design** principles. You will contribute to a robust, scalable architecture while working with modern cloud, containerization, and microservices technologies.

* Contribute to API-first, mobile-first, security-by-design, and privacy-by-design solutions.

* Extensive experience working in a self-organizing Scrum team.

* Excellent command of **Dutch**, both spoken and written.

* **HBO-level working and thinking ability**.

* **RavenDB NoSQL**

* **Docker**

* **Kubernetes**

* **Microservices**

* **Google Cloud**

* **Microsoft Azure**

* **Cloud Functions**

## Work Arrangement

* Flexible working environment with a combination of office-based and remote work.

* Collaborative Scrum team environment.

* Access to modern development tools and technologies.

* **Salary:** €3,400–€6,800 per month

* **24 vacation days** plus additional benefits

jobs.description:
# Full-Stack Developer

## About the Role

As a Full-Stack Developer at ORTEC LogiqCare, you will work within an innovative, international organization focused on applying software engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to healthcare. The Clinical Care & Research team develops software applications for medical care and biomedical research, including clinical decision-making tools, medical workflow support, and scientific research applications across areas such as cardiovascular medicine, oncology, lung disease, rheumatology, pregnancy, and toxicological prediction models.

You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle using modern architecture and development practices. The healthcare platform uses microservices, CQRS, event sourcing, and domain-driven design, with Angular and TypeScript for frontend development and C# for backend development.

## Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop full-stack software applications for healthcare and biomedical research.

* Create software designs using established design patterns and SOLID principles.

* Write clear and effective technical designs.

* Develop frontend applications using Angular, TypeScript, Cypress, and Playwright.

* Develop backend applications using .NET 10.0 and C#.

* Build and support cloud-based solutions using Microsoft Azure.

* Work with Azure services including App Service, Web Jobs, Application Insights, CosmosDB, Service Bus, and Azure SQL.

* Participate in an agile software development environment.

* Conduct and participate in code reviews.

* Develop and maintain unit tests.

* Contribute to continuous integration and continuous deployment processes.

* Apply or develop knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

* Contribute to modern software architecture using microservices, CQRS, and event sourcing.

* Participate in on-call duties to support customers 24/7, approximately eight weeks per year.

## Required Qualifications

* Experience with software design, including design patterns and SOLID principles.

* Experience writing technical designs.

* Frontend development experience with Angular and TypeScript.

* Experience with frontend testing tools such as Cypress and Playwright.

* Backend development experience with .NET 10.0 and C#.

* Experience with cloud development, specifically Microsoft Azure.

* Experience working with relevant Azure services such as App Service, Web Jobs, Application Insights, CosmosDB, Service Bus, or Azure SQL.

* Experience working in an agile software development environment.

* Experience with code reviews, unit testing, and continuous integration/deployment.

* Willingness to participate in on-call support duties approximately eight weeks per year.

* Willingness to work in a collaborative and continuously learning environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

* Strong interest in Domain-Driven Design and modern software architecture.

* Experience with microservices architecture.

* Experience with CQRS and event sourcing.

* Experience developing software applications for healthcare or biomedical research.

## Skills & Competencies

* Full-Stack Software Development

* Software Architecture

* Design Patterns

* SOLID Principles

* Technical Design

* Angular

* TypeScript

* Cypress

* Playwright

* C#

* .NET 10.0

* Microsoft Azure

* Azure App Service

* Azure Web Jobs

* Application Insights

* CosmosDB

* Azure Service Bus

* Azure SQL

* Domain-Driven Design

* Microservices

* CQRS

* Event Sourcing

* Agile Software Development

* Code Reviews

* Unit Testing

* CI/CD

* Problem Solving

* Continuous Learning

* Team Collaboration

## Work Arrangement & Schedule

* Permanent position.

* Remote work is supported with a well-equipped home workspace and IT resources.

* Home working allowance and compensation for private internet connection are provided.

* On-call customer support is required approximately eight weeks per year to support customers 24/7.

* Additional compensation is provided for on-call duties.

## Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary.

* Mobility allowance of 3% of gross monthly salary covering commuting and business mileage, or the option of an NS Business Card.

* Pension contributions.

* Holiday pay.

* 25 vacation days, with additional days granted from age 35.

* Home working allowance.

* Compensation for private internet connection.

* Well-equipped remote workspace, including furniture and IT resources.

* Professional development programs tailored to individual needs and role requirements.

* Opportunities to attend courses and seminars.

* Hands-on experience and opportunities to work abroad.

* Employee activities and a collaborative working environment.

## Company & Culture

ORTEC operates internationally with more than 1,000 employees across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Greece, France, the U.K., Romania, Italy, the U.S., Australia, Brazil, Poland, Denmark, and Singapore. The organization promotes an open, informal, cooperative, and positive atmosphere with a flat organizational structure and short communication lines.

## Application Process

Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting a CV and motivation letter. The recruitment process includes an online assessment followed by two interviews.

jobs.title: .Net Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

ESolutions is a leading technology solutions provider dedicated to delivering innovative software products and services to clients across various industries. With a strong focus on quality, agility, and customer satisfaction, ESolutions has established itself as a trusted partner in digital transformation initiatives. Our team of skilled professionals is committed to leveraging the latest technologies to create scalable, efficient, and reliable solutions that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our dynamic team at ESolutions. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of software projects, ensuring that quality standards and scope expectations are consistently met. You will contribute to the technical design and architecture of our systems, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and partner technology groups to develop innovative solutions. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of .NET technologies, strong programming skills, and experience in designing scalable, microservice-based architectures.

Qualifications

Proven experience with .NET/.NET Core frameworks and a solid understanding of object-oriented principles.
Extensive experience in developing ASP.NET Core Web APIs and implementing RESTful API techniques.
Proficiency in C# programming language.
Strong knowledge of multi-threading and asynchronous programming models.
Hands-on experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Experience with containerization tools such as Docker.
Background in designing and building service-oriented or microservice architectures.
Experience with automated testing frameworks like Nunit, Moq, or Cucumber.
Familiarity with middleware messaging services such as RabbitMQ, TIBCO, or SignalR.
Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools like Git and TeamCity.
Understanding of Agile development methodologies and software lifecycle processes.

Responsibilities

Take ownership of software delivery processes, ensuring that all projects meet quality standards and scope requirements.
Contribute to and own the technical design of systems, ensuring comprehensive documentation of architecture and components.
Collaborate effectively with partner technology teams to align on technical strategies and implementation plans.
Develop and maintain scalable APIs and microservices, ensuring robustness and performance.
Implement multi-threaded and asynchronous programming techniques to optimize application performance.
Design, develop, and optimize database schemas and queries for SQL and NoSQL databases.
Utilize containerization tools like Docker to streamline deployment and environment consistency.
Implement automated testing protocols to ensure code quality and facilitate continuous integration.
Work with middleware messaging services to enable reliable communication between distributed systems.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, contribute to sprint planning, and continuously improve development workflows.

Benefits

At ESolutions, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your professional growth and personal well-being. Our benefits include competitive salary packages, health insurance, paid time off, and opportunities for ongoing training and certification. We foster a collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages continuous learning and career advancement. Additionally, we promote work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and support initiatives that enhance employee engagement and satisfaction.

Equal Opportunity

ESolutions is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring practices are designed to promote diversity and ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and contribute to our company's growth.
